title: Development and Trends of Contemporary Higher Education

creators.name: Mun Cheah and Kenneth Y T Lim, Horn
Matamala and Desirée Mora Cruz, Carolina

summary: In recent years, global higher education has undergone unprecedented transformation due to the deepening of globalization, rapid advances in digital technology, and the profound impact of the recent global pandemic. Against this backdrop, this volume invites scholars from relevant fields to share their insights and research findings on the development and trends of contemporary higher education, providing academic communities and policymakers with verifiable results and evidence.
